title: Ottauquechee Formation
description: Rusty weathering dark gray to black carbonaceous pyritiferous phyllites with subordinate lithologies that include silvery gray and grayish green phyllites; gray, fine to medium grained, granular quartzites

title: Jay Peak Formation
description: Fine grained, light gray green quartz-chlorite-albite phyllitic schist and quartzite; white quartzofeldspathic layers alternate with green chloritic phyllitic layers

title: Hazens Notch Formation
description: Gray and rusty, quartz-albite-sericite-chlorite graphitic schist with albite porophyroblasts and minor epidote, calcite, garnet, biotite and sphene; medium-grained, massive, light gray and green banded quartz-albite-muscovite gneiss with minor epidote, chlorite, sphene, and magnetite

title: Fayston Formation
description: Silvery green, medium grained, muscovite-quartz-albite-chlorite-garnet-magnetite schist with thin light gray quartzites

title: Underhill Formation
description: Silvery gray-green quartz-albite-chlorite-sericite ± magnetite schist and phyllite

title: Ultramafic Units
description: Massive, brown to white weathering, green, partially to completely serpentinized dunite and peridotite

title: Ultramafic Units
description: Talc-carbonate rock, quartz-carbonate rock, and steatite
